programme.desc: Carolyne explores the gorgeous town of Sorrento, Italy. Scotty continues his trip in South Africa and samples some of the local delicacies. Lynton makes a splash in Denarau, Fiji. And Susannah wraps up her discovery tour of New York.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Challenges
programme.desc: Still reeling from the blow to their budget, can Hastings couple Joe & Maria regroup and find a home? And in Wellington Americans Bonnie & Matt want a warm, dry home for their family and they’ve come up with a bold plan.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Race for the Place
programme.desc: Will Bonnie and Matt’s dreams of prefab living come true or will it all come crashing down? And in Hamilton, animal lovers Monique and Chris need to find their first home in a hurry.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "ASCOT & DUBAI
programme.desc: We visit one of the newest cities in the world – Dubai. We discover have an absolute gem tucked away near Ascot in the English countryside.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "SICILY & LOS ANGELES
programme.desc: The majestic yet somewhat sinister volcano of Mount Etna overlooks the delightful city of Taormina in Sicily. Then its time to jet across the Atlantic and check into Hotel Bel-Air Los Angeles.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "ST. PETERSBURG & LONDON
programme.desc: This episode takes our team east to Russia to discover its former capital – the magical city of St Petersburg. Well next off our lucky crew head to England to visit the Dorchester hotel in London.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Income for a Rainy Day (Part 2)
programme.desc: Vezi works in the music industry, so Inez lines up some special surprises to wow her clients! This episode has special guest appearances by designer and rockstar Sergio Galli of Platinum Blonde, and musicians Amy Sky and Marc Jordan.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Tricky Choice (Part 1)
programme.desc: Laura and Steven are a couple with an expanding family, and are ready to take the next steps in home ownership. They want a large plot of land for their young children to run around, and a spacious home that reflects this new phase of their life.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Tricky Choice (Part 2)
programme.desc: Steve Bailey is the man for the job, and with such great homes to choose from, Laura and Steve will be hard pressed to pick just one.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Fishing Charter
programme.desc: The couple test their skills running a fishing charter. How will two bed & breakfasters in France cope with their biggest challenge? On the Costa Blanca, a family pulls together to try and rescue their Spanish dream.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Pop-Up
programme.desc: The vineyard owners open a pop up restaurant in a stunning location. Two B&B hosts an event in a bid to boost takings. In Spain, a wannabe fishing captain has to learn the ropes.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Observatory
programme.desc: It’s decision time for a couple hoping to run a fishing charter business. How will two B&B cope with some tricky customers? And with their first guests now booked in, will an observatory business France please it’s punters.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Vintage Twist
programme.desc: Johanna and Pete explore a collection of Australian vintage homes that have been masterfully renovated to meet the needs of modern living without destroying the past.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Inventive Architecture
programme.desc: Explore a collection of houses that have one thing in common - the designers have come up with inventive ideas and radical approaches to solving everyday design issues. It's both clever and inspiring with plenty of take home tips for the home renovator.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Little Gems
programme.desc: Modern city living has it challenges mostly around space. Johanna and Pete look at homes that make the most out of the space they have. These little gems may change the way you think about living in small spaces.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona
programme.desc: Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night
programme.desc: Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Chiang Mai - Eze
programme.desc: From Asia to Europe this episode explore the cultures and magnificent architecture in Chiang Mai and Eze in the South of France.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Ice Hotel, Sweden - Bangkok
programme.desc: From the hustle and bustle of Bangkok to the freezing temperatures of the Ice Hotel in Sweden, this episode is all about polar opposites, fire and ice.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "St Tropez - St Lucia
programme.desc: Romantic Caribbean Islands and sleeping fishing villages turned European jet set resorts, this episode travels from St Lucia to St Tropez.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "City Escape - Miami
programme.desc: To educate our children about the profound impact of travel we travel to Miami, Florida. We'll learn about the area's colorful history, taste test its cuisine, learn Latin dancing and experience an epic adventure through the everglades.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Eco-Explore Your Backyard - California Coast to Santa Barbara
programme.sub-title: Eco-Explore Your Backyard - California Coast to Santa Barbara
programme.desc: In this episode we remind viewers just how much you can find when exploring your own backyard by road tripping the California Coast to Santa Barbara! Swapping TV time to chats around the campfire and an exciting encounter with sea lions.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Big Resort, Big Heart - Atlantis Bahamas
programme.sub-title: Big Resort, Big Heart - Atlantis Bahamas
programme.desc: If the Atlantis Bahamas isn’t on your family's bucket list - it should be! We’ll show you why as each family member ticks off their dream adventure that also gives back. Proving this big resort has an even bigger heart.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Agra and Its Environs
programme.desc: Agra is home to India’s most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. We tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal’s construction.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "The Land of Rudyard Kipling: Kanha & Bandhavgarh National Parks
programme.sub-title: The Land of Rudyard Kipling: Kanha & Bandhavgarh National Parks
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling’s wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Bangalore and Ooty
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "We Bought a Resort (Part 1)
programme.desc: Sofie heads back to Belize to help husband and wife team Rachel and Ben size up some properties. Along with their investors, the couple are looking to purchase a resort on the island of Ambergris Caye that will provide the most bang for their buck.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "India
programme.desc: Jonathan begins a quest to find an extreme type of holy man reputed to eat human flesh and commit other blatant acts of embracing taboos in a strange path to nirvana.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "India Part 2
programme.desc: In a country where anything can be found, Jonathan is unsurprising to find women in different roles and status, but the extremes are shockingly diverse and unexpected.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Japan
programme.desc: The duo hits Tokyo’s food mecca for Michelin-starred sushi and ramen, ending their journey by cooking for a high-stakes charity auction.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "New Caledonia
programme.desc: In their final stop, Karena and Kasey blend Pacific produce with French techniques, visiting the Isle of Pines to cook for savvy local foodies.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweet After Bitter
programme.desc: From Teochew sweetrice cakes in China, sugarcane in India, to chocolate in Ivory Coast, this episode tells the story of how humans pursue and obtain sweetness, and how sweetness provides comfort and warmth to humanity.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Hawaii
programme.desc: Chris travels to Hawaii’s Big Island, hikes to the heart of a volcano and takes a night dive that brings him face to face with dozens of giant manta rays.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Kangaroo Island
programme.desc: Chris takes a photo challenge on beautiful Kangaroo Island and finds himself swimming in some unusual company.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Matthieu Dupuis Baumal – Chateau de la Gaude
programme.sub-title: Matthieu Dupuis Baumal – Chateau de la Gaude
programme.desc: In this program we’ll explore the story of the skilled Chef Matthieu Dupuis Baumal, his style of cooking and how he took his team to greatness in only a couple of months! We’ll also visit one of the best olive oil producers in the world.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Amandine Chaignot – Pouliche
programme.desc: In this program Amandine Chaignot demonstrates the extent of her talent, serving refined vegetarian-focused cuisine. We’ll get to know her secrets for stimulating flavors and the principles behind her raw, refined French cuisine.
